permissions.loadError: The permission catalog could not be loaded.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles bundle permissions. Built-in roles are fixed; custom roles are defined per product.
roles.customDescription: Defined for this product. Editable by users with roles:manage.
roles.customEmptyBody: Create a role when the built-in roles do not fit.
roles.editorDescription: Choose the permissions this role grants.
roles.name: Name
roles.deleteBody: Members with the role “{{name}}” lose the permissions it grants.
roles.keyHelp: Stable identifier used in memberships, e.g. “support_agent”. Cannot be changed later.

scopeHelp.product: Assigned to product operators; may hold product and tenant permissions.
scopeHelp.tenant: Assigned to tenant members; holds tenant permissions only.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Keys let machines call the Axentra API for this product with an explicit permission list. A key that a service creates with another key expires no later than that key and is revoked together with it.
keys.createDescription: The secret is shown exactly once after creation.
keys.name: Name
keys.nameHelp: Describe where the key is used, e.g. “billing-worker production”.
keys.tenantScopeHelp: Optional. A tenant-scoped key can only access data of that tenant.
keys.emptyBody: Create a key for each service that calls the API.
keys.rotateBody: A new secret is generated for “{{name}}”. The old secret stops working; update all services that use it. Keys created with this key keep working.
keys.revokeBody: “{{name}}” stops working immediately, and so does every key that was created with it (and the keys created with those). This cannot be undone.
keys.secretWarningBody: It is shown only this once and cannot be recovered. Store it in a secret manager.
keys.secretConfirm: I have stored the secret securely
keys.grace: Grace period for the old secret
keys.graceHelp: Lets running services switch over without downtime.
